body.message: Hello,We note your response; however, we do not agree with your position.The statement that the deduction was “previously communicated” does not constitute a valid or legally sufficient basis for withholding funds.For clarity:– No bed bug issue was identified or documented during the official check-out inspection  – No signed inspection report exists confirming any such issue at the time of handover  – The claim was introduced only after check-out  – The provided pest control invoice (AED 525) does not justify a deduction of AED 1,400  – The invoice itself is addressed to your company, not to us, and does not establish tenant responsibility  As such, there is no documented or contractual basis for the deduction.Accordingly, the remaining amount of AED 1,400 is considered unjustifiably withheld.We hereby request the immediate transfer of the outstanding balance within 24 hours.Failing this, we will proceed with further escalation through the Department of Economy & Tourism and other applicable channels.Kindly confirm once the transfer has been completed.Regards,  Mikhail KantsavenkaM KOn 8 Apr 2026, at 11:30, Chahana | fäm Living <deposit@famliving.com> wrote:﻿Hello Mikhail,Thank you for your confirmation regarding the refund you have received.Regarding the pending amount of AED 1,400, we would like to clarify that the deduction was previously communicated to you along with the reason for it. As such, we are unable to process this amount for refund. We sincerely appreciate your understanding in this matter.Kind regards,Chahana T.On Wed, Apr 8, 2026 3:36 AM, gomelmike@gmail.com wrote:Thank you for the transfer.However, the amount received is AED 16,275, leaving an outstanding balance of AED 1,400.This deduction remains unjustified and unsupported by any signed or agreed documentation at the time of check-out.We will be updating the DET case accordingly to reflect the partial payment and unresolved balance.Kindly arrange the immediate transfer of the remaining AED 1,400 and confirm once completed.Best regards,M KOn Tue, Apr 7, 2026 3:10 PM, gomelmike@gmail.com wrote:Following up again.We have provided all required details and confirmed the account earlier today.As of now, there is still no confirmation that the transfer has been initiated.Please note that this matter is already under review with DET, and we will be updating the case to reflect the continued delay in processing the refund.At this stage, there are no outstanding items from our side, and no valid justification for any deductions.We expect confirmation that the FULL refund of AED 17,675 has been initiated today.Kindly confirm immediately and share the payment confirmation.This delay is not acceptable.We have fully cooperated and there is no valid reason to withhold or delay the refund.If the transfer is not initiated today, we will proceed with further escalation through DET and formally document the continued non-payment.We still prefer to resolve this today.Please confirm once the transfer has been initiated.Best regards,M KOn Tue, Apr 7, 2026 5:01 AM, gomelmike@gmail.com wrote:Hello,Following up again.All required details have already been provided and confirmed, and there are no remaining blockers for the transfer.We are still been initiated today.Thank you.Best regards,M KOn Mon, Apr 6, 2026 11:56 AM, Chahana T. wrote:Hello Kamola,To confirm the deposit refund, we have received the bank details; however, the name provided differs from the booking name. The name we received is Mikhail Kantsavenka.Kindly confirm if we should proceed with the refund to this account.Chahana T.On Mon, Apr 6, 2026 11:07 AM, gomelmike@gmail.com wrote:Following up.We are still awaiting confirmation of the full refund of AED 17,675 today.Please confirm the transfer status.Best regards,M KOn Mon, Apr 6, 2026 10:01 AM, gomelmike@gmail.com wrote:Dear Chahana,We strongly disagree with your position.1. The alleged “bedbug issue” was raised only after checkout and is not supported by any jointly signed inspection report. Furthermore, pest issues were reported during the stay and are already documented.2. The provided invoice does not establish tenant liability and cannot justify any deduction. No evidence has been provided that the issue was caused by us.3. The claimed deduction for “items left in the apartment” is also unsupported. No signed inventory, report, or agreed deduction has been presented.4. As previously stated, no valid justification has been provided for any deductions.The full amount of AED 17,675 has already been formally claimed and submitted in the DET complaint.Given the above, we do not accept any deductions and expect the full amount to be refunded immediately.Please confirm that the remaining balance will be transferred without delay.Failing this, the matter will continue to be pursued through DET and other appropriate channels.Regards,  MikhailBest regards,M KOn Mon, Apr 6, 2026 9:05 AM, Chahana T. wrote:Hello Mikhail,Thank you for your message.As we mentioned previously, a deduction was applied for the removal of items left in the apartment. Additionally, during the inspection carried out after your checkout, the team identified a bedbug issue. The inspection was documented, and please find attached the receipt for the bedbug treatment conducted.Based on this, the refund has been processed accordingly, and the amount you will be receiving has been clearly stated.We appreciate your understanding and cooperation regarding this matter.Kind regards,Chahana T.On Mon, Apr 6, 2026 4:25 AM, gomelmike@gmail.com wrote:Hi,Kind but urgent request that the full amount of AED 17,675 has already been formally submitted in the DET complaint.No valid justification has been provided for any deduction.Therefore, we expect the full amount to be refunded today.Kindly confirm that AED 17,675 will be transferred today and provide confirmation once initiated.Best regards,M K
